'''Lianyue''' is an NPC in {{Location|Jinzhou}}. She can be found next to [[Chenpi]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Lianyue:''' The lost heart is like a flower blooming alone in the [[Dim Forest]]. Its scarlet color remains, but fragile and indistinct, with scars running down its body.
:{{DIcon}} Are you reciting a poem?
:'''Lianyue:''' Eek! You startled me for a moment there... If it isn't the Night Champion, {{Rover}}?
:'''Lianyue:''' Through fading thorns, has the hero finally arrived to rescue the maiden wounded by the spikes?
:{{DIcon}} You must've gotten the wrong person.
:'''Lianyue:''' Have I? It seems that the dusty memories cannot be awakened by a single sentiment after all.
:'''Lianyue:''' You and I are like two meteors flying off in opposite directions, only til we fall can we seek redemption from the sins of convergence...
:{{DIcon}} ...
{{Dialogue End}}
